fields.heading: How a program *comes together*
fields.intro: Length and format are set by your needs, not by a fixed syllabus.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: We meet leadership and department heads, and map the work that takes the most time.

steps.title: A curriculum from your documents
steps.text: Exercises are rebuilt around your own files, reports and systems, not textbook examples.

steps.title: Sessions that end in a deliverable
steps.text: Each session ends with something working: a tested prompt, an automated workflow or an internal tool.

steps.title: Support after
steps.text: Refreshers and follow-up help keep the new habits going as the tools change.

fields.heading: Start with a *free pilot*
fields.body:
Before you commit, we run one 2-hour session for a group of your staff on the AI landscape and prompting.

It runs on-site at your office, or online over Microsoft Teams. There is no commitment.

fields.heading: Trained in *real sessions*
fields.note: Artificia's own count across its corporate training sessions.

items.label: professionals trained through corporate training sessions

items.name: Alphonsa N. P
items.role: Chief Nursing Administrator, Aadicura Super Speciality Hospital
items.quote: Joining Artificia was an eye-opening experience. The AI training is highly practical and directly applicable to modern healthcare operations.

items.question: How long is a program?
items.answer: As long as your goals need. Length and format are set after discovery, around your departments and your team's schedule.

items.question: Can the training run online?
items.answer: Yes. Sessions run on-site at your office, or online over Microsoft Teams and similar tools. A mix of both also works.

items.question: Who should attend?
items.answer: Anyone who works with documents, data or customers. Departments can attend together while each works on exercises for its own role.

items.question: What does each session deliver?
items.answer: Something your team keeps using: a tested prompt, a working automation or an internal tool, built on your own work.

items.question: Is our company data safe?
items.answer: We agree in writing what may never be uploaded and which tools are approved. Staff are trained to check AI output before it reaches a customer.

items.question: How does the free pilot work?
items.answer: We run one 2-hour session for a group of your staff on the AI landscape and prompting, on-site or online. There is no commitment.
